On top of that structure, they find a magenta_banner (task 2) and green_concrete (task 3) as landmarks/waypoints. The green_concrete block serves as a visual marker pointing toward a room containing a pink_bed, which must be mined (task 4). This creates a natural multi-hop chain: climb → observe landmarks → navigate to target → interact. The tasks require no deep Minecraft crafting knowledge — just navigation, observation, and basic block breaking.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the ladder on the building's south face. The ladder is at spawn-relative (5, 2, 4) — the midpoint of the 4-block ladder. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=16 allows seeing it from spawn distance since the ladder is clearly visible from the starting position, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the magenta banner inside the main building room. The banner is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 6). The player must enter the building through the doorway and face the banner. max_distance=8 ensures the player has actually entered or is very close to the building interior (not just standing outside), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the banner.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the green concrete block on the east interior wall of the main building. The green concrete is at spawn-relative (10, 1, 7). The player must be inside or near the building and facing the green concrete. max_distance=8 ensures proximity (they need to be inside the building), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the block which serves as a directional marker toward the second room.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as an item into the player's inventory. When a pink_bed block is broken (by hand or any tool), it drops exactly 1 pink_bed item. The player must navigate to the second room and break the bed, which places it in their inventory. No special tool is required to mine a bed.

scene_description: A two-room stone brick structure on a flat platform. The main building has a ladder on its south exterior face (visible from spawn), a wide 2-block doorway on the west face, a magenta banner inside on the floor, and a green concrete marker on the east interior wall. A second smaller room to the east contains a pink bed, accessed through a doorway connecting the two structures. The green concrete visually guides the player eastward toward the bed room.
task_text: Find the ladder on the building, then enter the building to find the magenta banner and green concrete block inside. The green concrete marks the direction to a second room — go there and mine the pink bed.
design_notes: Ladder at (~5, 0-3, ~4) on south face - clearly visible from spawn. Wide doorway at (~4, 1-2, ~6-7) for easy entry. Magenta banner at (~7, 1, ~6) inside main room. Green concrete stack at (~10, 1-2, ~7) on east wall pointing toward second room. Second room doorway at (~13, 1-2, ~7). Pink bed at (~15-16, 0, ~7) inside second room. All items at ground level - no climbing required for find tasks. The ladder serves as the first landmark to locate the building.
